plan: Given my value of $13, I aim to bid slightly above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit. Assuming rationality, others bid close to their values. The average value is $24.5. To win, my bid should be above the lowest expected bid. I estimate this to be around $12. Therefore, I will bid $12.1 to potentially win the auction while ensuring I don't overpay relative to my value.

Given my value of $15, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly above the expected third-highest bid. Since values are uniformly distributed, the expected third-highest bid is around $16.3 (mean of $0-$49). To win, I should bid slightly above this while ensuring profit. Given my private value of $47, the goal is to bid just below my value to maximize potential profit while minimizing loss. Since all bidders are rational, they will also aim to bid close to their own values. I will bid slightly below my value, at $46.9, to ensure a win if others bid lower, while paying the third-highest bid. This maximizes my expected profit since the prize value is high.
